sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This petition is filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C., by the petitioners seeking to enlarge them on bail in the event of their arrest in Crime No.307/2023 of Mahalakshmipuram Police Station, registered for the offence punishable under Sections 419 and 420 of IPC.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners, learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent / State and perused the material on record.
3.

The aforementioned case is registered on a complaint lodged by one Sri.Nikhil Kashyap against the accused by name Santosh Rao, wherein it is alleged that the said accused has cheated him to the tune of Rs.1.4 crore.

The gist of the complaint averments are that in the year 2019, complainant entered into a business deal with the said accused and he was forced to invest a sum of Rs.1,05,00,000/- (Rupees One Crore Five Lakhs Only) and believing the words of the accused, he invested the money without any documentation.
The company came to be registered on 03.06.2019.
One Sharath Kumar also invested a sum of Rs.15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakhs only).

It is alleged that the accused has used funds for his personal purposes by transferring them to their personal bank accounts and thereby cheated the complainant to the tune of Rs.1,04,00,000/-.
5.

It is alleged by the complainant that he, along with the accused by name Santosh Kumar started a building management software company by name M/s. Space Monk Technologies Private Limited,
in which he invested a sum of Rs.1,05,00,000/- and got the company registered on 03.06.2019.
One Sri. Sharath Kumar invested an amount of Rs.15,00,000/- and all the three were appointed as directors of the company.

It is alleged that the accused misused the funds of the company for his personal affairs by using the company NC: 2024:KHC:6552 bank account to pay the income tax of Priyanka Rao vs State By on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173251519/
2 his father to the tune of Rs.86,730/- and Rs.13,170/- in the name of his father-in-law.

It is further alleged that the accused, without the knowledge of the complainant, has drawn the salary to his Kotak Bank Account bearing No.5412972884 and Axis Bank Account No.912010018825562 to the tune of Rs.1,00,00,000/- and caused financial loss to the company.
6.
The petitioners are the wife and father-in-law of accused No.1.
In the complaint, it is alleged that accused No.1 has registered a flat jointly in his name and in the name of his wife.

7. It is submitted that the petitioners were issued with a notice under Section 41(a) of Cr.P.C. and they appeared before the Police, however, the police are constantly harassing them under the guise of investigation and therefore, they are apprehending arrest.
8.
A reading of the complaint averments at this stage does not indicate that the petitioners are also involved in the business transactions.
Accused No.1 who was arrested on 31.12.2023 has been enlarged on bail by the learned NC: 2024:KHC:6552 Magistrate.

It is contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioners have no role to play and have no connection whatsoever in the functioning of the company, wherein accused No.1 and the first informant are the directors.
9. Considering the above facts and circumstances, it is just and proper to grant the relief sought by the petitioners by imposing necessary conditions.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER i) Petition is allowed.

ii) In the event of arrest of the petitioners/accused in Crime No.307/2023 of Mahalakshmipuram Police Station now transferred to Nandini Layout Police Station registered for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420 of IPC, they shall be released subject to following conditions:
a.

They shall appear before the Investigation Officer within a period of ten days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- [Rupees One Lakh only] each with one surety for the likesum.
b. They shall cooperate with the investigation and shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence / witnesses in any manner.

They shall be available for the Priyanka Rao vs State By on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173251519/
3  investigation of the case, whenever  required.
d.
